newsitem.title: USA: KEDO seeks 140,000 tonnes fuel oil for Aug-Sept.
newsitem.headline: KEDO seeks 140,000 tonnes fuel oil for Aug-Sept.

text.p: The Korean Peninsular Energy Development Organization on Friday tendered to buy 140,000 metric tonnes of fuel oil for August through September.
Offers are due on August 20 at 1000 EDT (1400 GMT).

KEDO is seeking two cargoes of about 22,000 tonnes each, with a maximum 2 percent sulfur content, one to be delivered to Nampo/Songrim, North Korea, during August 26-31, and one to be delivered after September 20.

It is also seeking 20,000 to 60,000 tonnes for Sonbong, North Korea during August 26-31, and 35,000 to 96,000 tonnes for Sonbong in September, said KEDO's broker, Washington-based International Services Corp.
KEDO, an international organization set up to stop the spread of nuclear weapons in the Korean peninsula, has agreed to supply North Korea with 500,000 tonnes of fuel oil annually.
